topic: Facility access system design for multiple locations
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on determining the best technical approach for managing user access to facilities, particularly in preparation for a new airport launch and existing mall requirements. Two main options were discussed: 1) Utilizing an interpartner system for access management, or 2) Building a custom system where facility data is pulled based on individual user IDs and associated permissions. The latter option requires modifying the existing code that retrieves facility information to use `user_id` instead of company identifiers. This change was deemed necessary despite potential initial underutilization.
decisions: Implement a custom system for managing facility access, pulling data based on user IDs and associated permissions.
action_items: [p1] to meet with [me] tomorrow to finalize the decision regarding the facility access system.
